title: chaos-wrestling-alliance-1996-international-world
label: "Stunning" Scott Alexander

lost.source: The fed's own 6 October 1996 broadcast: the broadcast team debates on-air "was there a point to stripping Scott Alexander of the International World Title? No," placing the stripping at or around this fed's own summer 1996 shutdown / October relaunch, before this card aired.

how: Stripped of the title without a match; the fed's own broadcast team characterizes the decision as a byproduct of the summer shutdown and October relaunch rather than an in-ring loss.
